title: Converge presubmit runners, add dependency summarizer and lightweight release prober
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Converged presubmit lint/test runners into a single lightweight adapter; added a small dependency summarizer tool that surfaces top transitive/update candidates in PRs; added a non-blocking release prober to reduce noisy post-merge rollbacks.
description:
Context and motivation: Our presubmit matrix has grown organically and causes slow feedback for small changes. Teams run slightly different lint/test entrypoints; this PR converges the most common runners into a single lightweight adapter with a mode switch for language-specific plugins. It also introduces a tiny CLI 'dep-summarizer' that produces a short list of dependency update candidates (top 5 by transitive impact) and a lightweight release prober that runs a smoke validation after merge windows to detect release regressions early.

What this PR does (high level):
- Decomposes multiple presubmit entrypoints into one path: ./ci/presubmit/runner.ts with plugin hooks for go/python/ts.
- Adds tools/dep-summarizer (Go) that analyzes go.mod / package.json lockfiles and emits a short human-readable summary included in PR comments.
- Adds a release-prober job that runs a small set of high-value smoke checks against a staged artifact in the release pipeline (non-blocking by default).
- Removes deprecated shell wrappers in scripts/ci-presubmit-*.sh and updates README and devcontainer.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implement consolidated runner and plugin interface
- [x] Add dep-summarizer and unit tests
- [x] Add release-prober job and smoke-tests

Commits (summary):
- 7a3f2b2: introduce presubmit runner adapter and plugin API
- d4c1a01: migrate typescript lint/test shards to new runner
- b28f0c9: add go/python plugin shim and tests
- e9d5b4a: add tools/dep-summarizer with basic reporter
- f12a9c3: add release-prober GitHub action and smoke test suite
- 11c2e77: remove legacy shell wrappers and update docs

Changed areas (representative list):
- ci/presubmit/runner.ts (new unified entrypoint)
- ci/presubmit/plugins/* (language adapters)
- tools/dep-summarizer/* (go module + package.json analysis)
- .github/workflows/release-prober.yml (new non-blocking job)
- scripts/ci-presubmit-*.sh (removed)
- docs/dev/ci-presubmit.md (updated)

Small illustrative snippet (runner plugin registration):
const runner = new PresubmitRunner({plugins: [new TsPlugin(), new GoPlugin(), new PyPlugin()]});
await runner.run(process.argv.slice(2));

Review conversation (high level):
- Liam Chen (reviewer): "Nice consolidation. Two asks: make the plugin API explicit about timeouts and make dep-summarizer tolerant of private registries. Also can we gate the release-prober to a flag for early rollout?"
- Maya Patel (author): "Addressed — added timeout field to PluginSpec and fallback timeouts in the runner. Dep-summarizer now accepts registry config via .depconfig. Release-prober is behind workflow input 'enable_prober' (default false)."
- Aisha Grant (reviewer): "Runner tests look good; small nit on log levels. Verified the prober job doesn't block merge. Approving after nit fix."
- Omar Rodrigues: "Left a comment about expanding dep-summarizer heuristics later; happy to approve now."

CI summary:
- Unit: pass
- Integration (smoke): pass
- Lint: pass (ts, go, py)
- E2E: skipped in presubmit fastpath; nightly job added for full-e2e

Merge notes and rollout:
- Merged with squash.
- Feature flag rollout: presubmit runner enabled org-wide after 72 hours of monitoring; release-prober disabled by default and enabled per-team using workflow input.
- Ops: Added a small alert in ticketing to watch for unexpected presubmit timeouts.

Related work and links: Linear: ENG-4821 (presubmit consolidation), ENG-4956 (dep summarizer prototype). Internal docs: https://internal.redwood.company/docs/ci/presubmit.

Why this is different from previous CI work: Instead of splitting lint/test shards further, this consolidates the entrypoint and provides a plugin SDK so teams can opt in to language-specific behaviour without proliferating top-level workflows. The dep-summarizer is intentionally conservative (non-blocking) and aims to surface human-actionable hints rather than auto PRs.

If anything goes wrong: rollback plan is to revert the workflow change and re-enable legacy wrappers (scripts archived under scripts/archived/*).

notes_to_release_engineers: Release prober is disabled by default. To enable for a team, set 'enable_prober: true' in the team's release workflow dispatch inputs. Dep-summarizer configuration (private registries) can be provided via .depconfig at repo root.
post_merge_actions: Monitor presubmit latency metrics for 72h; check 'presubmit-runner.timeout' alerts. If >3% of PRs hit fallback timeout, roll back and investigate plugin-specific regressions.
